description: Finalize a local file upload started with upload_file_start. Call this only AFTER the upload command (or, for an image or zip, the curl PUT) has finished successfully. Pass exactly one of: asset_id (a video: verifies every part landed in storage and starts video processing), image_url (an image) or upload_id (a live animation zip: checks it has a page to play, else says what to fix). An image or a zip creates the asset here - at the team's top level, in folder_id, or as a new version of version_of - titled title. Safe to retry: a repeat returns the same asset.

asset_id.description: The asset_id (version id) upload_file_start returned for a video

folder_id.description: Image or zip only: folder to create it in (omit for the team's top level)

image_url.description: The image_url upload_file_start returned for an image

team_id.description: Team to act in: the team.id an earlier result named. Omit for the team selected in the Flask app (which the user can switch at any time).

title.description: Image or zip only: title for the new asset (defaults to the file name for an image)

upload_id.description: The upload_id upload_file_start returned for a live animation zip

version_of.description: Image or zip only: add it as a new version of this asset (any of its ids). For a video it is ignored: the version is attached at upload_file_start.

name: upload_file_complete
title: Finish local file upload
